{{Quote|Coruscant is one big city. When a blaster misses its target, it hits ''something'' else. The less weapons are fired, the less chance some innocent bystander will be injured.|Mace Windu|<ref name="Shadows of Coruscant">{{WizCite|book=Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook|story=Shadows of Coruscant}}</ref>}}
A '''weapon permit''' was an authorization used in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. It was given to members of security forces, allowing them the right to carry a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapon or other kind of weapons &mdash; although indiscriminate use of weapons were still prosecuted even if the shooter had a permit.

Apparently, members of ambassadorial delegations did not need this permit; neither did members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to carry [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].
